description: Reads one event's prices (id from events or odds) at each bookmaker and exchange carrying it, narrowed to the bookmakers and markets you name. Needs a key that can read raw odds. Spends tokens: priced first, and refused when it would cost more than max_tokens.

bookmakers.description: Only these bookmaker or exchange keys

id.description: An event id such as or_evt_da71d5873e85

limit.description: Most bookmakers to return; a note counts the rest

markets.description: Only these market keys, such as h2h

max_tokens.description: Refuse the call when its quoted price is above this many tokens. Ask the user before raising it.

region.description: Region code. Left out, the API uses uk.

name: event_odds
title: Event odds
